A single isolated subject painted in opaque gouache, in exactly the brushwork, paint texture and quiet balanced palette of the reference image, and nothing else: flat opaque shapes with dry-brush edges, a few fine colored-pencil details, no outlines.

OBJECT: A small soft rain cloud in dusty lilac-grey with a pale ochre sun peeking out from behind it and three tiny raindrops.

Only a soft painted contact shadow beneath. No people, no hands. Simple, bold shapes that stay readable when the picture is very small. Quiet, balanced color, about six parts light, three parts mid-tone and one part strong: cool near-white paper, pale washes, sand and oatmeal neutrals; mid-tones of dusty aubergine, muted terracotta-rose, greyed ochre, sage and dusty blue do most of the work; at most one or two small strong accents of clear mango yellow #F6A723 or deep plum #2A2140. No pure saturated primaries. Warm natural brown skin tones in varied shades.
